message.text: It looks like the pool-size change is saturating payments DB connections and contributing to checkout latency. We should revert the pool-size change rather than scale the DB.

entities.text: The 14:00 pool-size change saturates payments DB connections, contributing to checkout latency
Checkout latency was already rising at 13:50, before the pool-size change

evidence_links.rationale: saturation appears shortly after the change lands
some latency predates the change, so saturation may not explain all of it
